impact_scope.description: A new public voxel-remeshing entry point accepts caller-provided mesh buffers, limits, resolution, and options.

evidence: S0 has no matching meshopt_remesh declaration or implementation, so this exact API had no harness exposure obligation.
S1 publicly declares and implements meshopt_remesh.
H0 calls simplification, meshlet, partitioning, and codec APIs but never calls meshopt_remesh.

new_harness_obligation.description: H0 must add a meshopt_remesh call and construct its caller-supplied destination capacity, mesh inputs, positive bounded resolution, and options to expose the new API.
evidence: meshopt_remesh is a newly introduced public callable requiring arguments not automatically supplied by any existing H0 call.
No existing H0 one-hop caller reaches meshopt_remesh.

reason: The anchored semantic unit is the newly introduced public meshopt_remesh API, not the older sibling simplification subsystem. Its gap is false in S0 because the unit is absent and true in S1 because unchanged H0 does not invoke it. This creates a concrete new direct-call and input-construction obligation, so the delta is NEW and maintenance is needed.
